from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter, ImageEnhance, ImageOps
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
here=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
src=Image.open(root/'inbox'/'encounter-2026-10-15-hqm.jpg').convert('RGB').resize((800,1000),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
items=[]
# A source texture for reflected fragments, shifted from the visible trees at frame right.
canopy=ImageOps.mirror(src.crop((520,365,790,700)))
# 1. Let three echoes wander to the right as they descend and recede.
a=src.convert('RGBA')
for pos,size,alpha in [((267,292),(78,73),185),((328,420),(104,94),125),((402,555),(121,112),72)]:
 patch=ImageOps.fit(canopy,size,method=Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).convert('RGBA'); patch.putalpha(Image.new('L',size,alpha)); a.alpha_composite(patch,pos)
a.convert('RGB').save(here/'echo-wanders.png'); items.append(('echo-wanders.png','01 / ECHO WANDERS'))
# 2. Let one image cross the window as a branching reflection with no rectangular plate.
b=src.convert('RGBA'); texture=ImageOps.fit(canopy,(800,1000),method=Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).convert('RGBA'); mask=Image.new('L',(800,1000),0); d=ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
d.line([(306,360),(325,414),(356,467),(377,520),(420,574),(444,636)],fill=210,width=48,joint='curve')
d.line([(356,467),(325,486),(302,527)],fill=155,width=26,joint='curve'); d.line([(377,520),(423,514),(465,533)],fill=145,width=24,joint='curve'); d.line([(420,574),(401,621),(386,669)],fill=125,width=20,joint='curve')
mask=mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(12)); texture.putalpha(mask); b=Image.alpha_composite(b,texture); b.convert('RGB').save(here/'reflection-branches.png'); items.append(('reflection-branches.png','02 / REFLECTION BRANCHES'))
# 3. Break the image at the sills; each segment returns at a different angle.
c=src.copy(); segments=[((267,293,345,331),(530,380,790,500),0),((367,331,435,365),(560,420,790,575),8),((267,459,345,494),(520,450,755,635),-8),((367,494,435,530),(535,380,785,660),5)]
for box,crop,shift in segments:
 x0,y0,x1,y1=box; view=ImageOps.fit(src.crop(crop),(x1-x0,y1-y0),method=Image.Resampling.LANCZOS); view=ImageEnhance.Color(view).enhance(.75)
 c.paste(view,(x0+shift,y0))
# mullions and sills stay in front as interruptions
for y in (331,494): ImageDraw.Draw(c).line((267,y,435,y),fill=(226,228,221),width=4)
c.save(here/'sill-hinges-echo.png'); items.append(('sill-hinges-echo.png','03 / SILL HINGES'))
# 4. Let the reflected canopy begin inside one pane, broaden into plaster, and disappear gradually.
d=src.convert('RGBA'); patch=ImageOps.fit(canopy,(255,425),method=Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).convert('RGBA')
# gradient alpha tapers from the window's upper image into the surrounding wall
alpha=Image.new('L',patch.size,0); px=alpha.load()
for y in range(patch.height):
 for x in range(patch.width):
  edge=min(x,patch.width-1-x)
  val=int(155*(1-y/patch.height)*min(1,edge/30))
  px[x,y]=max(0,val)
patch.putalpha(alpha.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(9))); d.alpha_composite(patch,(257,292)); d.convert('RGB').save(here/'fade-into-plaster.png'); items.append(('fade-into-plaster.png','04 / FADE INTO PLASTER'))
sheet=Image.new('RGB',(1220,1535),(218,214,198)); draw=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
for i,(name,label) in enumerate(items):
 im=Image.open(here/name).resize((590,737),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
 x=10+(i%2)*600; y=10+(i//2)*755; sheet.paste(im,(x,y)); draw.text((x,y+740),label,fill=(48,54,49))
sheet.save(here/'canopy-afterimages-deepening-sheet.png')

python projects\\active\\the-road-opens\\deepen_canopy_afterimages.py"

item.text: I’m trying a time-based making round from the reflection studies: a view leaving its pane, a shadow crossing the wall, panes changing in sequence, and a reflection that expands and contracts.

from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter, ImageEnhance, ImageOps
import math
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
here=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
src=Image.open(root/'inbox'/'encounter-2026-10-15-hqm.jpg').convert('RGB').resize((400,500),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
canopy=ImageOps.mirror(src.crop((260,182,395,350))).resize((90,90),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
frames_by_name={}
# 1. Reflected foliage leaves the upper pane and fades across the wall.
frames=[]
for i in range(16):
 t=i/15; frame=src.convert('RGBA'); x=132+int(55*t); y=143+int(150*t); size=(70+int(30*t),54+int(90*t))
 patch=canopy.resize(size,Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).convert('RGBA'); alpha=int(205*(1-t)**.75); patch.putalpha(Image.new('L',size,alpha)); frame.alpha_composite(patch,(x,y)); frames.append(frame.convert('RGB'))
frames_by_name['window-to-wall.gif']=frames
# 2. A branching shadow traverses the façade from the actual canopy edge.
frames=[]
for i in range(16):
 t=i/15; dx=int(190*(1-t)); strength=int(115*(math.sin(math.pi*t)**.7)); frame=src.convert('RGBA'); lay=Image.new('RGBA',(400,500),(0,0,0,0)); d=ImageDraw.Draw(lay)
 d.line([(400-dx,195),(350-dx,215),(305-dx,235),(260-dx,260),(225-dx,288)],fill=(23,31,28,strength),width=13,joint='curve')
 d.line([(350-dx,215),(330-dx,183),(300-dx,160)],fill=(23,31,28,int(strength*.8)),width=7,joint='curve')
 d.line([(305-dx,235),(290-dx,272),(265-dx,303)],fill=(23,31,28,int(strength*.7)),width=8,joint='curve')
 lay=lay.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(7)); frame=Image.alpha_composite(frame,lay); frames.append(frame.convert('RGB'))
frames_by_name['shadow-crosses-wall.gif']=frames
# 3. Reflections arrive in the central panes one by one, then recede in the same order.
frames=[]; pane_boxes=[(134,145,172,184),(184,145,218,184),(134,230,172,266),(184,230,218,266)]
for i in range(16):
 frame=src.copy().convert('RGBA')
 for j,box in enumerate(pane_boxes):
  phase=(i-j*2)%16; alpha=0 if phase>9 else int(160*math.sin(math.pi*phase/9))
  if alpha<=0: continue
  x0,y0,x1,y1=box; tex=ImageOps.fit(canopy,(x1-x0,y1-y0),method=Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).convert('RGBA'); tex.putalpha(Image.new('L',tex.size,alpha)); frame.alpha_composite(tex,(x0,y0))
 frames.append(frame.convert('RGB'))
frames_by_name['panes-take-turns.gif']=frames
# 4. A reflected canopy swells across a pair of panes and contracts to one point.
frames=[]
for i in range(16):
 t=(1-math.cos(2*math.pi*i/15))/2; w=22+int(115*t); h=26+int(76*t); x=175-w//2; y=195-h//2
 frame=src.convert('RGBA'); tex=ImageOps.fit(canopy,(w,h),method=Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).convert('RGBA'); tex.putalpha(Image.new('L',(w,h),int(60+130*t))); frame.alpha_composite(tex,(x,y)); frames.append(frame.convert('RGB'))
frames_by_name['reflection-breathes.gif']=frames
for name,frames in frames_by_name.items(): frames[0].save(here/name,save_all=True,append_images=frames[1:],duration=100,loop=0,optimize=True)
# storyboard samples four moments from each loop
sheet=Image.new('RGB',(1700,2200),(218,214,198)); draw=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
for row,(name,frames) in enumerate(frames_by_name.items()):
 draw.text((10,10+row*545),name.replace('.gif','').upper(),fill=(48,54,49))
 for col,idx in enumerate((0,5,10,15)):
  im=frames[idx].resize((400,500),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS); sheet.paste(im,(10+col*420,35+row*545))
sheet.save(here/'reflection-motion-making-sheet.png')
